Dana (People Ops): FYI Ravi in Product handed in his resignation this morning. Last day set for 2026-05-15. He asked about benefits continuity, HSA transfer, and the possibility of doing short-term consult work after leaving. Need to coordinate COBRA packet, final paycheck, equipment return, and legal check on consulting.
Sophie Li: Confirmed. We're planning KT the week prior (5/08-5/12). Exit interview tentatively 5/14 10am.
Ravi Kumar: Happy to help with post-exit consulting for 2-4 weeks if that helps transition. Open to 1099 but want to know the steps.
Dana (People Ops): @Benefits Bot can you outline COBRA/HSA steps for Ravi and send the standard packet?
Benefits Bot: Auto: COBRA election window = 60 days from termination notice. Coverage typically ends end-of-month of last day; detailed options will be emailed. HSA funds remain with the custodian; employee can transfer to a personal HSA. Link: https://benefits.example.com/COBRA-HSA.
Payroll: Payroll cutoff for May run is 2026-05-10. With a 5/15 last day, final pay will include accrued PTO payment if manager approved by 5/09. Please confirm.
Sophie Li: Approved PTO payout in our offboard checklist. @Payroll confirm amount once HR pushes final hours.
IT Ops: For hardware, Ravi is remote in CA. We can mail a pre-paid return label or schedule a courier pickup. I'll open IT-5910. Prefer courier on 5/18 morning so deprovision can run after last-day snapshot.
Dana (People Ops): On deprovision timing, we default to revoke SSO and API tokens 24 hours after last day unless a documented extension is requested. @IT Ops plan?
IT Ops: Plan: snapshot home dir and user data on 2026-05-16 04:00 UTC then run deprovision at 09:00 UTC 2026-05-16. Commands to run:
```
rsync -a /home/ravi /mnt/offboard/ravi_20260516
chown -R sophie.li:product-team /mnt/offboard/ravi_20260516
./deprovision-user --user ravi --archive-ssh-keys
```
We'll also rotate any service account keys Ravi had access to and add PM as owner.
Sophie Li: I'll make sure ownership is transferred on the Confluence KT page.
Dana (People Ops): Legal check: post-employment consulting must be vetted to avoid conflicts and IP issues. I'll loop in Legal and add a flag on the offboard tracker for 'possible contractor'.
Ravi Kumar: If it helps, I have a short list of tasks I can do as consultant: small bug fixes, doc cleanup, on-call handover for two weeks. Budget TBD.
Dana (People Ops): Noted. Legal will need a scope + rate if manager wants to proceed. Manager to submit request via legal-requests channel.
Benefits Bot: Reminder: COBRA election forms will be mailed within 14 days after termination is processed. Employee must return signed form within 30 days to keep continuous coverage.
Payroll: We'll calculate final pay after Sophie confirms PTO hours by 2026-05-09. Expect payout on next payroll run (5/28).
Sophie Li: I'll upload KT artifacts and the list of consulting tasks to Confluence and tag Legal + Dana.
Dana (People Ops): I'll update the offboard tracker with COBRA dates, IT ticket, payroll notes, and legal flag. Anything else?
Ravi Kumar: Please confirm laptop return label when available. I prefer courier pickup.
IT Ops: We'll update IT-5910 with courier slot and email Ravi the label by 2026-05-12.
Sophie Li: Thanks all. Ravi if you want to discuss consulting details DM me and I'll start the legal request. :raised_hands:
Dana (People Ops): Closing loop here — offboard checklist updated and next steps assigned.
